Definition: of Hebrew origin (H4993); Mattathias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite and a Christian:--Mattathias.
BiblicalUsage: Mattathias appears twice in Luke's genealogy, once as the son of Amos and once as the son of Semei. Two men of the same name stand on the long road from David to Jesus.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a repeated name is not a mistake but a reminder: ordinary men, named twice over the generations, are the links in the chain that brings the Saviour.
